name: Fission
pros: High sensitivity and easy to drive
cons: Treble can show a peak for sensitive listeners
Sub-bass is not the most elevated
insight: Fission uses Tanchjim’s newer DMT5 dual-magnetic dual-chamber driver in an aluminum shell with interchangeable nozzles and a modular cable (including USB-C). Reviewers praise its clean midrange, detail, and overall refinement at a competitive mid-tier price.
